messages:
Aisha: Heads up — Ivy preview cohort: 5 unconfirmed seats, 4 low-activity signups. Proposing a short office hours drop-in tomorrow 11am PT to unblock. Can someone create a 3-question micro-survey and a canned Slack DM for outreach?
Jonah: I can do survey + DM. Keep survey tiny: issue summary, impact (low/med/high), want 1:1? checkbox for "At-risk" + freeform note.
Maya: I'll co-host and prepare a 2-slide "first 10 min" demo: SDK setup + token scope pitfalls.
Lee: Slack DM draft: "Hey {{name}} — joining Ivy sandbox? We’re hosting 45m office hours tom 11am PT to help with setup. Drop in or book a 1:1: <cal.link/ivy>. Quick survey: <forms/ivy-quick>." Paste troubleshooting checklist: https://redwood.example/docs/onboard/ivy-checklist
Aisha: Perfect. Use tag ivy-office-2026-q1 on the form so we can filter responses. Also we need Trello webhook to create cards for any "At-risk" checks.
Jonah: Draft survey text below — pls sanity check: ```1) Short description of issue (one line) 2) Severity: low / medium / high 3) Want a 1:1? Yes / No [Optional] Notes: (text) [Checkbox] CS follow-up (At-risk)``` 
Maya: LGTM. Suggest auto-redirect high severity to booking flow.
Aisha: Ops ask: can eng enable a batch log exporter for the cohort before the call? If we need logs during triage, we don't want to wait.
Lee: Run this to pull recent logs if needed: ```rsi collect --cohort ivy --since 48h --anonymize``` — returns a share link. I'll seed the run now.
OnboardBot: Reminder set — office-hours invite will post to #ivy-cohort 30m before start.
Jonah: I'll wire the DM + survey and post to cohort channel. Also I'll add simple analytics: response + at-risk flag -> Trello card -> assignee CS-team.
Aisha: Thanks. Post-call: drop one-line outcome in #customer-success: e.g., "Ivy office-hours outcomes: 12 attendees; 3 at-risk -> cards created (SLA 48h)." :thumbsup:
Maya: I'll do the 5-min slide and be ready with 1:1 slots. See you all.
Lee: Added the checklist link to the calendar event and pinned it in channel.
Aisha: Sending invites now.
